title: CoT Obfuscation Stress-Test Kit Under Monitor Pressure

original_idea.body: # CoT Obfuscation Stress-Test Kit. Run an open reasoning model on tasks with a known incriminating step under increasing monitor-awareness prompts; measure monitorability drop at fixed accuracy; output an obfuscation-susceptibility score.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests the load-bearing assumption behind CoT-monitoring safety cases; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompting-only stress test + monitorability scoring; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused susceptibility-score kit; defining incriminating steps + scoring adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-model stress test of a safety-case assumption; labs underweight.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on open reasoning models, single GPU/API.

novelty.reasoning: Source paper already stress-tests CoT obfuscation under monitor pressure; kit largely overlaps.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Source paper covers obfuscation stress-testing; this mostly packages it.
